summary: Two-way sync between Firestore collections and spreadsheet tabs, for clients who still work in sheets. Firestore is the source of truth: document changes reach their rows through a Firestore trigger and a task that writes the current state; a person's edits arrive signed from Apps Script and apply only where the app still holds what the sheet showed, else the row says there is a conflict. Typed columns, read-only columns, formula-safe writes, replay protection, nightly reconcile.

namePrefix.label: Resource name prefix
namePrefix.help: Short, lower case, e.g. acme. Prefixes every resource, so two applications in one project do not collide.

firestoreLocation.label: Firestore location
firestoreLocation.help: Where the project's (default) Firestore database is, e.g. nam5 or asia-southeast1 (Firebase console > Firestore > the database's location).

app_secrets.SHEETS_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Signing secret shared with the spreadsheets' Apps Script

nextSteps: SECRET="$(openssl rand -base64 32)"; printf %s "$SECRET" | scripts/secrets.sh set SHEETS_WEBHOOK_SECRET   # the same $SECRET goes in each Apps Script's SHEETS_SECRET
Name the synced collections in api/lib/sheets/sheets_config.dart, and the same collections in infra/app.auto.tfvars.json as api_env.SHEETS_COLLECTIONS
Share each spreadsheet with the application's service account (Terraform output service_account_email), as Editor
In each spreadsheet: Extensions > Apps Script, add sheets/apps_script/Code.gs and appsscript.json, set API_URL and SHEETS_SECRET in Script properties, run install()
